name: Auto Computation - Admin Dashboard (Overview & Live Stream)

parameters.query:
WITH 
today_info AS (
  SELECT CURRENT_DATE::TEXT AS today_str
),
staff_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE UPPER(COALESCE(role, 'EMPLOYEE')) = 'EMPLOYEE') AS total_employees,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_active = TRUE AND UPPER(COALESCE(role, 'EMPLOYEE')) = 'EMPLOYEE' AND id NOT LIKE 'ADM%') AS active_employees
  FROM employees
),
attendance_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status IN ('PRESENT', 'ON_TIME', 'WITHIN_BUFFER', 'LATE', 'HALF_DAY')) AS present_today,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status = 'ON_TIME') AS on_time_today,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status = 'WITHIN_BUFFER') AS within_buffer_today,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status = 'LATE') AS late_today,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status = 'HALF_DAY' OR a.is_half_day_case = TRUE) AS half_day_today,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status = 'ABSENT') AS absent_today,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.status = 'LEAVE') AS on_leave_today
  FROM attendances a
  JOIN employees e ON e.id = a.employee_id
  WHERE a.date = CURRENT_DATE 
    AND UPPER(COALESCE(e.role, 'EMPLOYEE')) = 'EMPLOYEE'
    AND e.id NOT LIKE 'ADM%'
),
pending_leaves AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
  FROM leave_requests
  WHERE status = 'PENDING'
),
pending_overtime AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
  FROM overtime_records
  WHERE status = 'PENDING'
),
punches_feed AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object(
    'id', COALESCE(a.id, 'none-' || e.id),
    'employeeId', e.id,
    'employeeName', (e.first_name || ' ' || e.last_name),
    'designation', e.designation,
    'avatarUrl', e.avatar_url,
    'role', e.role,
    'checkIn', a.check_in,
    'checkOut', a.check_out,
    'status', COALESCE(a.status, 'PENDING'),
    'statusLabel', COALESCE(a.status_label, 'Awaiting Punch'),
    'isHalfDayCase', COALESCE(a.is_half_day_case, FALSE),
    'lateAllowanceUsed', a.late_allowance_used
  ) ORDER BY 
    CASE WHEN a.check_in IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
    a.check_in_timestamp DESC NULLS LAST,
    e.id ASC), '[]'::json) AS feed
  FROM employees e
  LEFT JOIN attendances a ON a.employee_id = e.id AND a.date = CURRENT_DATE
  WHERE e.is_active = TRUE 
    AND UPPER(COALESCE(e.role, 'EMPLOYEE')) = 'EMPLOYEE'
    AND e.id NOT LIKE 'ADM%'
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT today_str FROM today_info) AS today_date,
  (SELECT active_employees FROM staff_stats) AS total_employees,
  COALESCE((SELECT present_today FROM attendance_stats), 0) AS present_today,
  COALESCE((SELECT on_time_today FROM attendance_stats), 0) AS on_time_today,
  COALESCE((SELECT within_buffer_today FROM attendance_stats), 0) AS within_buffer_today,
  COALESCE((SELECT late_today FROM attendance_stats), 0) AS late_today,
  COALESCE((SELECT half_day_today FROM attendance_stats), 0) AS half_day_today,
  COALESCE((SELECT absent_today FROM attendance_stats), 0) AS absent_today,
  COALESCE((SELECT on_leave_today FROM attendance_stats), 0) AS on_leave_today,
  (SELECT count FROM pending_leaves) AS pending_leaves_count,
  (SELECT count FROM pending_overtime) AS pending_overtime_count,
  (SELECT feed FROM punches_feed) AS feed;
